blockedOne: The imported record needs an evidence file before it can be submitted, and an import cannot attach one. Open it below to add its invoice.
blockedMany: All {count} imported records need an evidence file before they can be submitted, and an import cannot attach one. Under Previous submissions, attach each invoice to the records it evidences — one file can cover several.
confirmOne: Send 1 record for review. Only a reviewer can send it back — there is no way to un-submit it yourself.
confirmMany: Send {count} records for review. Only a reviewer can send them back — there is no way to un-submit them yourself.
refusedOne: It needs attention first — see below.
refusedMany: All {count} need attention first — see below.
cleanOne: {count} record is now in the review queue.
cleanMany: {count} records are now in the review queue.
rateLimited: Too many submissions in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
roleForbidden: Your role cannot submit activity records.

block.rejected: Sent back by a reviewer — open it on its own, so the note gets read.

capRefused: {max} records is the most one submission can carry.
selectedFirst: Selected the first {taken}. {more} more can go in a second submission.
